title: 动作动词辨析
goal: 根据动作的对象和结果辨析动词。

points.label: 区分动作动词的核心含义
根据动作对象与结果选择动词

body.p: 动作动词的意义涉及动作方式、对象和结果。辨析时结合事件：attempt 表示尝试，manage 表示设法完成。

body.box: She attempted to open the jar, but it remained shut. / She managed to open the jar.

body.p: 第一句的尝试没有成功，第二句的动作已经完成。

cards.title: 词汇表：观察
rows: She glanced at the clock. / He stared at the painting for a minute.
I noticed a mark on the leaf. / We observed the bird for an hour.
They watched the match. / The mechanic inspected the wheel.
She spotted a crack. / He examined the crack closely.

cards.title: 词汇表：移动
rows: We approached the gate. / We reached the gate.
She entered the hall. / She left the hall.
They climbed the hill. / They descended the hill.
He carried the box. / She dragged the heavy box across the floor.

cards.title: 词汇表：给予
rows: 主动提出给予 / 提供
She offered him a seat. / The school provided books for the class.
I lent her a pen. / She borrowed a pen from me.
He handed the ticket to the clerk. / She passed the salt to her friend.
They donated coats to a charity. / They shared a meal with a neighbor.

cards.title: 词汇表：完成
rows: He attempted to lift it but failed. / She managed to lift it.
They finished the project. / He abandoned the project halfway.
She solved the problem. / He identified the problem.
She achieved her goal. / He pursued his goal for years.

items.stem: Ella looked quickly at the clock before leaving. She ___ at it.
The travelers arrived at the gate after walking toward it. They ___ the gate, rather than merely moving toward it.
items.why: arrived at 说明已经到达，用 reached。

items.stem: The class needed books, and the school supplied them. The school ___ the books.
items.why: supplied 说明学校提供了书，用 provided。

items.stem: Liu tried to lift the table, but it did not move. He ___ to lift it.
items.why: tried 和 did not move 说明他尝试但没有成功。

items.stem: Nina gave her pen to Bo for the lesson; he would return it afterward. She ___ it to him.
items.why: 借给别人并约定归还，用 lent。

items.stem: The path went downward from the hilltop. The walkers ___ the hill.
The mechanic looked carefully at the wheel to find damage. She ___ the wheel.
items.why: looked carefully to find damage 对应 inspected。

items.stem: The box was too heavy to lift, so Ali pulled it along the floor. He ___ it.
items.why: pulled it along the floor 表示拖动。

items.stem: The teacher asked about the cause of the error. Mei found what it was but had not corrected it. She ___ the problem.
items.why: found what it was 表示找出问题，尚未解决。

items.stem: The team completed its project after several weeks. It ___ the project.
Asha asked if her neighbor would like a seat. She ___ him one.
items.why: asked if her neighbor would like a seat 是主动提出给邻居座位，用 offered。

items.stem: The family gave unused coats to a charity for others to keep. They ___ the coats.
items.why: gave unused coats to a charity 表示捐赠。

groups.fill: Our class prepared a display on Friday. I gla{nced} briefly at the clock and then wat{ched} my partner arrange the photographs. We appro{ached} the board, moving closer, and rea{ched} its far side. Our teacher off{ered} us a spare frame, and the school prov{ided} paper for labels. I le{nt} a pen to my partner temporarily; she borr{owed} it for a moment. We atte{mpted} to hang one picture, but it fell. Later we man{aged} to attach it securely.

items.stem: Kai looked at the bird continuously for several minutes. He ___ at it.
items.why: looked continuously for several minutes 对应 stared。

items.stem: The group moved toward the bridge but had not arrived there. They ___ the bridge.
items.why: moved toward 和 had not arrived 表示靠近而非到达。

items.stem: The student found the cause of the error and then corrected it. She ___ the problem, rather than merely identifying it.
items.why: found the cause and corrected it 表明问题已解决。

items.stem: Bo asked if May needed help carrying the books. He ___ to help her.
items.why: asked if May needed help 表示主动提出帮助。

items.stem: The rope was heavy, but after several tries Ana lifted it successfully. She ___ to lift it, rather than merely trying.
items.why: lifted it successfully 表明她设法完成了动作。

items.stem: The visitors came into the room through the open door. They ___ the room.
items.why: came into the room 对应 entered the room。
